page_title: ACM 0-1 ATA | AC Milan v Atalanta 20/04/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.

90+5' Wasted opportunity! Tijjani Reijnders (AC Milan) picked up a pass and had lots of options, but instead decided to shoot from distance and it went high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Atalanta.
90+3' AC Milan keep possession of the ball with some short passes, waiting for the moment to hit the opposition swiftly on the break.
90+1' Today's match ends for Mateo Retegui who will be replaced by Ibrahim Sulemana (Atalanta).
90' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.

90' Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) cuts inside his marker and unleashes a rocket of a shot from inside the box. The ball flies towards the bottom right corner, but it's kept out by magnificent save from Mike Maignan.
90' Samuel Chukwueze (AC Milan) decides to speed play up with a short corner kick.
89' 1:1 - the latest stats for both teams in respect of shots on target.

88' The most active player in today's match is definitely Ademola Lookman (Atalanta). He's trying to be on the ball as much as possible and you can literally see the enthusiasm in his play. He keeps exchanging some one touch passes and waits for the right moment to send a killer pass. What a player!

87' Joao Felix (AC Milan) has the goal in his sights after a good run to the edge of the box, but his weak effort flies well wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Atalanta will have a goal kick.
85' Santiago Tomas Gimenez (AC Milan) plays a through ball inside the box, but it's too strong and Marco Carnesecchi comes off his line to intercept.
83' We are about to witness a subsitution. Samuel Chukwueze (AC Milan) for Rafael Leao.
83' Sergio Conceicao has decided to make a change. Santiago Tomas Gimenez (AC Milan) replaces Fikayo Tomori.
81' Rafael Leao (AC Milan) plays a lovely through ball to Tammy Abraham, but he can't beat Marco Carnesecchi and loses the ball.
80' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Charles De Ketelaere (Atalanta) comes onto the pitch for Mario Pasalic.
79' AC Milan are bossing possession of the ball and make numerous short passes, but they finally lose possession after an error. The ball goes out of play and Atalanta will have a goal kick.
78' Tijjani Reijnders (AC Milan) connects with a pass but sees his shot from the edge of the box blocked.
75' Substitution. Riccardo Sottil (AC Milan) has come on for Christian Pulisic.
75' Sergio Conceicao has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Tammy Abraham (AC Milan) replacing Luka Jovic.
75' Alejandro Jimenez will be replaced by Joao Felix (AC Milan).
73' Mike Maignan leaps to intercept the corner kick from Ademola Lookman (Atalanta).

72' Atalanta are showing great team-chemistry. They are passing the ball around seamlessly but finally one of the defending players makes an interception. The linesman makes the right call and Atalanta will have a corner.
70' Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) sends over a poor, overhit cross from the corner kick and the ball goes out of play. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for AC Milan.

70' What a goal-scoring opportunity! Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) finds some space inside the box and gets in a strike, but the shot is brilliantly blocked by one of the defending players sliding in. Atalanta will take a corner kick.
68' Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) tries his luck and takes a shot from inside the box. His effort on goal is blocked by a defender.
67' Fikayo Tomori (AC Milan) tackles a bit over-zealously and Marco Piccinini blows for a foul.

62' 0 - 1 It's a goal! Ederson (Atalanta) bursts into the box to get on the end of a whipped in cross from Raoul Bellanova and scores magnificently from close range into the left side of the goal. 0:1.
61' Youssouf Fofana (AC Milan) has a go from a long way out but it sails way over. The ball goes out of play and Atalanta will have a goal kick.
59' A substitution has been made. Berat Djimsiti goes off and Odilon Kossounou (Atalanta) comes on.
59' Here is a change. Davide Zappacosta is going off and Gian Piero Gasperini gives the last tactical orders to Rafael Toloi (Atalanta).
59' It is time for a substitution. Matteo Ruggeri (Atalanta) is on for Juan Cuadrado.
56' Juan Cuadrado (Atalanta) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Marco Piccinini had an easy-decision to make.
55' Tijjani Reijnders (AC Milan) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender.
55' The referee awards a corner and Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) goes over to take it.

54' A pass by Youssouf Fofana (AC Milan) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end. Theo Hernandez (AC Milan) attempts to set up his teammate with a scoring opportunity by chipping in a fine pass from the edge of the box, but one of the defenders intercepts his effort. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to AC Milan.
54' Alejandro Jimenez (AC Milan) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. The ball is behind the touchline and AC Milan will take a throw-in.
52' Berat Djimsiti (Atalanta) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
52' Rafael Leao (AC Milan) receives a neat pass inside the box and instantly thumps the ball goalward, but a defender makes a last ditch block to deny him.
51' The resulting corner from Theo Hernandez (AC Milan) is cleared by the defence.
51' Youssouf Fofana (AC Milan) fires the ball from distance, but it's blocked by a defender. Good work from AC Milan as they win a corner.
47' AC Milan take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
47' Theo Hernandez (AC Milan) launches a powerful cross from the corner into the box, but the ball is intercepted by the defender. Corner kick. AC Milan will have an opportunity.

46' Tijjani Reijnders (AC Milan) produces an inaccurate low pass into the box that is blocked by the one of the defenders. If this pass had slipped through, the ball would have probably ended up in the back of the net. The referee points to the corner flag and AC Milan will take a corner.
46' Referee Marco Piccinini blows his whistle to start the second half.
45' The match has reached half-time.
44' Luka Jovic (AC Milan) receives a precise pass inside the box and takes a shot that flies just wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Atalanta.

42' That didn't go as planned! Rafael Leao (AC Milan) tried his luck from the edge of the box, but his effort low towards the middle of the goal was too weak to get past Marco Carnesecchi, who easily kept it out.
40' The number of shots on goal at present is 0:0.
39' Juan Cuadrado (Atalanta) threads a pass through the eye of a needle into the box for Mateo Retegui, but Mike Maignan displays great awareness to stop him.
36' Rafael Leao (AC Milan) received a clever through ball which could have put him in a promising position, but the defence was alert to the danger.

35' Mateo Retegui (Atalanta) reacts well and displays good awareness near the penalty spot to get on the end of a cross from the free kick. He jumps high and produces a header which goes well over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for AC Milan.
34' Youssouf Fofana (AC Milan) is penalised for holding. Marco Piccinini signals a set piece. Atalanta will take a free kick.
32' Juan Cuadrado (Atalanta) fouls an opponent during an attacking move.
30' Flag up against Rafael Leao (AC Milan). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
27' Matteo Gabbia (AC Milan) commits a rough challenge and Marco Piccinini blows his whistle for a foul. Atalanta are awarded the free kick.
27' Mario Pasalic (Atalanta) chips a pass over the line of defenders to get the ball to Ademola Lookman, but his attempt is intercepted and cleared.

25' The cross fools the defence and leaves Mateo Retegui (Atalanta) with an easy chance inside the box, but he mistimes his shot and sends it just wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for AC Milan.
24' The Atalanta players are exchanging short passes in an attempt to create a shooting opportunity.
21' Theo Hernandez (AC Milan) makes his forward run a little too early and is caught in an offside position after his teammate tries to play a pass to him.

20' Ederson (Atalanta) jumps for a cross and produces a fine header from near the penalty spot, but it goes narrowly wide of the left post! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for AC Milan.
18' Referee Marco Piccinini sees the trip by Ederson (Atalanta) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle.
17' Decent spell from Atalanta here and they keep the pressure on until one of the defending players steps in.
15' Raoul Bellanova (Atalanta) attempts to find one of his teammates inside the box with a chip pass, but one of the defending players reacts superbly and intercepts the ball.
13' Juan Cuadrado (Atalanta) delivers a crossfield pass, but the ball is cut out before it reaches its intended target.
9' Theo Hernandez (AC Milan) overhits the corner kick and none of his teammates can their head on it. The ball goes out of play and Atalanta will have a goal kick.
7' Mateo Retegui (Atalanta) is flagged for offside.
6' The foul by Davide Zappacosta (Atalanta) was seen by Marco Piccinini who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
5' Juan Cuadrado (Atalanta) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates.
5' Atalanta have a corner.
5' Theo Hernandez (AC Milan) tries to find Strahinja Pavlovic, but he puts too much power on the pass.
2' The corner from Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) is hurriedly cleared.

2' Rafael Leao (AC Milan) sends a long through ball to Theo Hernandez, but he fails to control it properly and loses it to one of the defending players. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to AC Milan.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
AC Milan will kick-off.
Let us introduce today's referee to you, and it's Marco Piccinini.
